confidence_notes: Meals, coffee and beer draw on a June 2026 crowdsourced snapshot from [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Kaohsiung). Cocktail and wine estimates use sparse local observations from [Expatistan](https://www.expatistan.com/cost-of-living/kaohsiung-city) and [a local menu](https://www.nikkokaohsiung.com/download/rb22-wine-list/), along with their premiums over beer. Accommodation is a season-sensitive model estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lodging estimates use a southern Taiwanese urban market, with Tainan as a regional comparison and a lower price level than Taipei.
